parameters.content:
## NWI - BC Contacts -> HubSpot contacts (daily): set up before publishing
1. Connect credentials: **HubSpot Service Key account** and **Business Central – NWI Group (client credentials)**. Confirm no "not connected" warning on any node.
2. Settings -> Error Workflow: set the shared error handler (not set in this file). Settings -> Timezone: Australia/Sydney, so the schedule means Sydney time.
3. BC web service **Contact_Card** (page 5050, name set in Workflow Config as bcContactPage) must be published: Segment, Sub Segment and IntegrationCustomerNo (the customer a contact belongs to) are read from it.
4. HubSpot contact property `business_central_record_id` holds the BC number and is how a record is matched. Dropdown values must include every BC value or that batch of 100 fails.
5. **Workflow Config** holds the lookback window (24h = from the moment the workflow runs back to 24 hours earlier), batch size and the BC-field -> HubSpot-property map.
6. Runs at 01:00, after the company sync, so a customer created today already has its company when its new contacts are created.

**What it does:** finds BC contacts created or changed in the 24 hours before the run. Missing in HubSpot (matched on `business_central_record_id`) -> CREATED and associated to the company of their BC customer (skipped when that customer has no HubSpot company, e.g. blocked). Already in HubSpot -> UPDATED, only properties whose value differs. BC wins. A blank in BC never clears HubSpot. Safe to re-run.

nodes.name: Every Day
nodes.notes: Runs once a day at 01:00 (set the workflow timezone to Australia/Sydney). Production runs only - publish the workflow.

nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes: lookbackHours: how far back from the run time to look (24 = the last 24 hours). matchProperty: HubSpot property holding the BC number. fieldMap: BC field -> HubSpot property.

nodes.name: List Changed BC Contacts

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.value: ={{ "type eq 'Person' and lastModifiedDateTime ge " + $now.minus({ hours: Number($('Workflow Config').first().json.lookbackHours) }).toUTC().toISO() }}

nodes.notes: One call: every contact created or modified in the window.

nodes.name: Build BC Read Batches
nodes.notes: Splits the contact numbers into batches (batchSize each). One item per batch.

nodes.name: Read BC Contact Details
nodes.notes: One call per batch: Segment, Sub Segment and the contact's BC customer number, from the BC contact card web service.

nodes.name: Find Matching Contacts
nodes.notes: Read-only search (POST is only the HubSpot search convention): one call finds the HubSpot records for a whole batch, with their current values.

nodes.name: Plan Contact Writes
nodes.notes: Existing contacts -> update payload with only the properties that differ. New contacts -> a plan with the BC customers they belong to.

nodes.name: Contact Write Type
nodes.notes: update = write changes to existing contacts. plan = new contacts to create and associate.

nodes.name: Update Contacts
nodes.notes: Batch update, up to 100 contacts per call. Only differing properties are sent.

nodes.name: Find Companies For New Contacts
nodes.notes: Read-only search: the HubSpot companies of the new contacts' BC customers, one call per batch.

nodes.name: Build Contact Creates
nodes.notes: Keeps new contacts whose BC customer has a HubSpot company; builds the create payload and the contact -> company pairs.

nodes.name: Create Contacts
nodes.notes: Batch create, up to 100 contacts per call. Create call: no retry, by design. A contact whose email already exists in HubSpot is rejected: the run stops with the details.

nodes.name: Build Associations
nodes.notes: Pairs each new contact with its company, in batches of 100.

nodes.name: Associate Contacts To Companies
nodes.notes: Default association (the company becomes the contact's primary company), up to 100 per call. Safe to repeat.

parameters.content:
## 1. Find changed BC contacts
One call lists everything created or modified in the lookback window.

## 2. Read details + find HubSpot records
Batches of 50: BC details in one call, matching HubSpot records in one search.

## 3. Create new + update changed
Changed contacts are updated. New contacts are created under their company and associated, 100 per call.
